Microphone and camera — for calls and capture, as in the original app.
Network — for the messenger to work.
Notifications — for messages and calls.

ul: You can delete all local modification data by uninstalling the app or clearing its data in Android settings.

Logs you send manually can be deleted in the app before and after sending.
